readability.rationale: Filter is a plain GET form; listReservations takes an optional equipment id; empty-state text names the filtered equipment.

maintainability.rationale: Reuses findEquipment for the filter parameter; one query serves filtered and unfiltered lists.

security.rationale: Query parameter accepted only as a digit string via findEquipment and bound as a SQL parameter; unknown ids fall back to all reservations; output escaped.

reliability.rationale: Read-only change; sort is deterministic (start date, end date, id).

scalability.rationale: Filtered query uses the equipment_id-leading index; whole-list rendering without paging is in scope for a local app (J-03 excludes paging).

compatibility.rationale: Works without JavaScript; filter state is in the URL, so it can be bookmarked.

tradeoffs: The unfiltered "No reservations yet." state is not E2E-tested because the E2E database is shared across tests in a run; the filtered empty state exercises the same branch.
